title: Crashes and freezes
text: I’m disappointed to report that since deciding to PAY for this app, it does nothing but freeze and crash. I’ll start a run on my phone, but then look down to discover it’s keeping track of time but not distance. I try to pause and restart only to discover the screen is frozen. Quitting and restarting the app does not help. Just finished my most recent run 20 mins ago and still can’t get the app to load. Super bummed out as I was excited to use their training programs to prepare for some races in my near future but it doesn’t seem possible! Hoping this is an issue that others are experiencing so they fix this problem. Willing to re-write my review if things change or improve!

title: Advert Notifications
text: I do not need a run tracker bad enough to have a notification nonstop that’s not even about me or my running. It’s triggering and intrusive. I have visceral reactions to being propositioned non stop on behalf of net profits. When will it be enough.

title: Where is support????
text: I have continued to have issues with the app since September 28 after starting a new plan. I reached out to support. Four days later I heard from someone about an update which I had already completed. I heard back the following day asking if it worked. No it did not was my response. Another three days pass and asked if I was still having issues. I said yes the same issues persisted. So here I am four days later (week 2 from reporting issues) and have yet to hear back at all. So disappointed!

title: Removed Apple Watch Support
text: I’ve been using Runkeeper for 10+ years. I was really disappointed when I went on my latest run to see that the app is no longer supported on my older Apple Watch. A warning that this was coming would have been really nice.

title: Needs multiple social media sharing options & an overhaul on the aesthetics.
text:
I’ve been using this app since 2012. I love most functions and statistics this app provides on my personal data. However, For the past year I’ve heavily considered using a different app.
The ability to share on social media from this app is mediocre. It needs an overhaul. Give us multiple aesthetically pleasing options for sharing our accomplishments on social media. Right now the share options are too cartoonish, simple, and boring. I am unable to share the pace of each mile for a long run, currently I have to screenshot and stitch together multiple images. 
I need more from this app or I’ll have to continue my fitness journey with a different platform.

title: Responsive customer service
text: Hi thank you for fixing my recent   App glitch for the paid subscription I’ve held form many years. While you remedied the situation to my satisfaction, the time it took to do so in an app I rely on every day could be improved upon. (6 day lag time on fixing a tech issue on a tech app)🤯

title: Not reliable
text: Disappointed did not read my pace and miles only time

title: Not keeping correct intervals
text: I have had this app for almost 10 years and it is a favorite of mine. Lately though, it has not been keeping track of my intervals , it keep saying the pace is 0:00/mile and it’s tough to keep track during a run while training for a race. Pretty disappointing

title: Can’t connect to Coros
text: There are instructions but the option is not inside the app to choose coros, perhaps they are outdated. Tracking with my phone obliterates my battery.

title: Too many popups
text: Too many popups in this ad. I don’t want to access your communities. I don’t want to take part in your dumb challenges. Quit popping up every time I complete a run. Ffs leave me alone

title: what the hell
text: the app controls are gone. i had used thus for many years and all of a sudden all there is  is a time and distance monitor that won't let me change anything. time to delete

title: Was a great app until recently
text: I use this app for over a decade, considered it absolutely phenomenal. However recently, the app started having some sort of issue where I couldn’t close it. So I deleted it and tried to reinstall it, and if since lost all of my account information workouts. And it seems that there’s no way to recover it.

title: Was great now not good
text: It was great in the beginning never had any problems, but now it won’t track. My heart rate won’t sync with my Apple Watch and won’t sync it the other apps that usually goes been having this problem for a couple weeks now.

title: Paywalling previously-free features is bad business.
text: Runkeeper used to show how each run stacked up with your previous outings, and then they one day decided to renege on that and put it behind a paywall. I think this is a lousy business practice, and deserves to be called out.

title: Clunky and dumb
text: It’s a free app, but still requires you to do all sorts of stupid hunting for all of the very obvious and basic features and entry points. It’s just as hard to enter data in the same thing as it is to do a full-blown workout.

title: IT support? lol, no
text:
I’ve been a Runkeeper customer for 10 years. Recently, upon trying to log back in, I received a JavaScript error “undefined is not an object.” I use the feedback button to contact the app developer, which promised they would reach out to me “right away.” over the course of multiple messages, I received one reply, suggesting I clear the cache, delete and reinstall. I did this multiple times, even changed the browser, and still receive the same error message. I’ve now informed them multiple times that their “fix” didn’t work - no help. I am still able to log onto the desktop version, so this is an app issue. Support from the developer has been really disappointing.
Update: now nearing two weeks that I’ve been unable to use the app.

title: Pausing
text: Pauses even when im still moving

title: Constant Sync Issues
text: The sync between Garmin and Runkeeper just stops working all the time with no warning and no way to it fix, other than manually uploading. Fix your integration. This app is useless as it currently is.

title: Pauses on runs
text: I’ve experienced multiple times that I ran a mile only to open Run Keeper and find it was paused the entire time. There needs to be greater friction when pausing the app. It seems that looking at the pause button is enough pressure for the app to decide to pause on the run.

title: Unable to log in
text: I had to purchase a new phone & installed Runkeeper on the new device. It will not allow me to log into my account. It tries to force me to create a new account. I click “sig in” but it defaults to creating a new account. I’ve had Runkeeper for years. I want to keep my old account & maintain my current activity streak.

title: App does not work
text: This app has a bug and only sometimes works - I have to restart my phone before every run or it doesn’t track time or distance!!!! So frustrating.

title: Meh…
text:
UPDATE: now it is giving me incorrect splits in the app, not just the audio. 

I will be using a different app. This is not worth the time or money. 

——
It does what’s needed, but not great. My biggest pet peeve is that about a quarter of the time, the audio setting tells me my current split is something bizarre like 100+ hours a mile. It’s recording the data correctly, but the audio while I’m running is saying it takes me five days for a mile. Huh?
